scope: Two complete still-image outfit candidates, not separated equipment layers, authored motion frames or runtime atlases.
checks: Original byte-identical to Git; RGBA/transparency/size/bounds; equal full-canvas scale review; face/anatomy/right-hand sword/red cloth sash/no gore visual inspection.
limitations: Generative edits are not pixel-identical outside clothing. Heavy blade is intentionally broader; light shoulder silhouette narrower and heavy coat longer. No CMake/CTest/runtime tests for art-only changes.
processing: Generated masters copied byte-for-byte. Review only premultiplied-alpha reduction and side-by-side layout, no recolor/repaint/flip/nonuniform stretch.
